transcript.message:
Hi Carlos, thanks for picking up—I really appreciate you taking the call. My name is Sarah Thompson, and I’m with ClearPath Financial Solutions. And I totally understand you’re in the middle of things—this won’t take long, and I’ll make sure everything is clear before we go any further.

The reason for my call is about an outstanding balance that’s been referred to us for resolution. I believe it’s related to a past-due account you had with EverGreen Credit Services, for an amount of $1,842. Before we go any deeper, I just want to confirm: is this something you’re familiar with? And is now still an okay time to talk, even briefly?

I know these calls can feel abrupt or stressful, so I just want to make sure you’re comfortable and we’re on the same page. I’m here to help, not to catch you off guard.
